summary: Rain Enhancement Technologies Holdco, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to attach a legal opinion (Exhibit 5.1) for a prospectus supplement to an existing S-3 shelf registration. The supplement covers an at-the-market offering of up to $3,513,524 of Class A common stock through Needham & Company as sales agent. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation event. The filing contains no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situations content.
